scenes.raw_story: Morning. The kitchen is still asleep. Only the soft hiss of water boiling in the kettle.
scenes.emotion: calm warm morning narrator, soft breathy tone

scenes.raw_story: Coffee pours slowly. The aroma begins to spread.
scenes.emotion: gentle savoring tone, slightly slower pace

scenes.raw_story: Open the window. Sunlight pours in like a greeting.
Sit down. Both hands wrapped around the warm cup. No rush to be anywhere.
An old book. A page held open. A few handwritten notes in the margin.
A morning slow enough to feel. Quiet enough to begin.
scenes.emotion: grateful warm conclusion, slight smile in voice
